verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Hoppscotch ships an MCP *server* that exposes its own collections/requests to external AI agents (docs-10, probe-3, probe-6) — i.e., Hoppscotch is the tool being plugged into an AI host, not a client that plugs into third-party MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence exists of Hoppscotch itself consuming external MCP servers as a client.
